desc.en: Unlimited public and private Git repos for up to 5 users with Pipelines for CI/CD
desc.zh: 最多 5 个用户可使用无限量公开和私有 Git 仓库，并提供用于 CI/CD 的 Pipelines

desc.en: Unlimited public and private Git repos for free and open-source projects (with unlimited collaborators). Powered by [Forgejo](https://forgejo.org/). Static website hosting with [Codeberg Pages](https://codeberg.page/). CI/CD hosting with [Codeberg's CI](https://docs.codeberg.org/ci/). Translating hosting with [Codeberg Translate](https://translate.codeberg.org/). Includes Package and Container hosting, Project management, and Issue Tracking
desc.zh: 为免费和开源项目提供无限量公开和私有 Git 仓库（协作者数量不限）。由 [Forgejo](https://forgejo.org/) 驱动。通过 [Codeberg Pages](https://codeberg.page/) 提供静态网站托管。通过 [Codeberg's CI](https://docs.codeberg.org/ci/) 提供 CI/CD 托管。通过 [Codeberg Translate](https://translate.codeberg.org/) 提供翻译托管。还包括软件包和容器托管、项目管理和问题追踪

desc.en: Framagit is the software forge of Framasoft based on the Gitlab software includes CI, Static Pages, Project pages and Issue tracking.
desc.zh: Framagit 是 Framasoft 基于 Gitlab 软件搭建的软件锻造平台，包含 CI、静态页面、项目页面和问题追踪。

desc.en: Unlimited private and public repositories. Free forever. Powered by GitLab & Sapphire. Includes CI/CD, Static Hosting, Container Registry, Project Management and Issue Tracking.
desc.zh: 无限量私有和公开仓库。永久免费。由 GitLab 和 Sapphire 驱动。包含 CI/CD、静态托管、容器注册表、项目管理和问题追踪。

desc.en: Unlimited public repositories and unlimited private repositories (with unlimited collaborators). Includes CI/CD, Development Environment, Static Hosting, Package and Container hosting, Project management and AI Copilot
desc.zh: 无限量公开仓库和无限量私有仓库（协作者数量不限）。包含 CI/CD、开发环境、静态托管、软件包和容器托管、项目管理以及 AI Copilot

desc.en: Unlimited public and private Git repos with up to 5 collaborators. Includes CI/CD, Static Hosting, Container Registry, Project Management and Issue Tracking
desc.zh: 无限量公开和私有 Git 仓库，最多 5 名协作者。包含 CI/CD、静态托管、容器注册表、项目管理和问题追踪

desc.en: Heptapod is a friendly fork of GitLab Community Edition providing support for Mercurial
desc.zh: Heptapod 是 GitLab Community Edition 的友好分支，提供对 Mercurial 的支持

desc.en: Unlimited free and open source distributed version control system. Its distinctive feature is based on a sound theory of patches, which makes it easy to learn, use, and distribute. Solves many problems of git/hg/svn/darcs.
desc.zh: 无限量免费且开源的分布式版本控制系统。其独特特性基于可靠的补丁理论，易于学习、使用和分发。解决了 git/hg/svn/darcs 的诸多问题。

desc.en: One free private project (Git and Subversion) with 50 MB of space
desc.zh: 一个免费的私有项目（Git 和 Subversion），50 MB 空间

desc.en: Repository Hosting based on Git. Unlimited Public and private repositories.
desc.zh: 基于 Git 的仓库托管。无限量公开和私有仓库。

desc.en: Serves as a collaborative software development management system for free Software projects (for GNU Projects)
desc.zh: 作为自由软件项目（GNU 项目）的协作式软件开发管理系统

desc.en: Serves as a collaborative software development management system for free Software projects (for non-GNU projects)
desc.zh: 作为自由软件项目（非 GNU 项目）的协作式软件开发管理系统
